restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมศิริ Siri dental clinic
text:
The clinic is good, there's parking, and the doctor and assistants are excellent. However, the reception staff needs significant improvement. First-time patients are made to wait and then told to fill out a medical history form, but without specifying what documents are needed. It's like they just call out the patient's name and speak vaguely. We don't understand what they want.
It would be better to call out the patient's name and invite them to the counter.
Also, medical history can be completed in advance during the appointment. Instead, patients have to fill out all the information by hand, some of which is irrelevant to the treatment. I don't understand what this information is for. If it's a marketing ploy, not filling it out for us means we're not available.
And if any additional documents are needed, they can be requested when the patient arrives to register their name and appointment time.
My appointment was at 11:00 AM, I arrived at 10:40 AM, but was made to wait for half an hour. At 11:10 AM, I was informed that I had to wait another fifteen minutes because there were walk-in patients trying to cut in, a doctor's consultation, and an accident. After 15 minutes, there was still no news.
When I inquired, the staff asked if I was comfortable waiting... I had already been waiting for almost an hour. Asking if I was comfortable waiting is just inconsiderate of the judgment of the staff.

If this is the case, what's the point of making appointments? The staff's queue management is terrible. Not respecting the time shows a lack of respect for others. Your time is valuable. And do patients' time not matter at all? It's terrible to let walk-ins cut in line like this.
